annotations.text:
Kept from today's grimoire.rs landing: header, hero, CTAs, footer, the whole token set (#161826 ground, #9184d9 accent, mono kickers, 8px radii).
New: the centred search field, the 'start from what you want to do' router (eight cards weighted by the owner's list, the friction logs and web pain points; each card names the complaint), a transcript-style demo frame in the hero, and a four-group footer nav that mirrors the sidebar.

Guide page = every docs page in the landing's own style (replaces mdBook navy).
Left: sidebar with the four groups from the discovery plan, current page in accent-900.
Centre: kicker (type · tier · time), goal before the first step, one result per step.
Right: on-this-page, a per-guide screencast slot, reference links, edit link.
Command refs and timings are sample copy.
